description:
Create a new hospital location using the OpenMRS Administration interface.

1. Open the browser and navigate to the OpenMRS Administration page: https://localhost/openmrs/admin
2. Log in with username 'superman' and password 'Admin123'.
3. Go to the 'Locations' section and click 'Manage Locations'.
4. Add a new location with the following details:
   - Name: Pediatrics Ward
   - Description: Ward for pediatric inpatient care
5. Make sure to tag the location as a 'Visit Location' so it can be used for patient visits.
6. Save the location.

The task starts from the Bahmni Home page.
